text:
Maria Chen: quick sync — planning an SI live-labs mentor rotation for Q3 onboarding. goal: run 3 parallel hands-on cohorts, ensure mentors have hw windows + proctoring for certs. thinking weekly rotations, 4 mentors per cohort. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Samir Patel: sounds good. do we already have mentor volunteers from the integrator pool? i can pull last quarter's roster. also need timezone spread (APAC/NA/EU).
Anika Rao: we should lock the playbook first — entry checklist, sample lab timeline, assessment rubrics, and a short mentor guide (15–20m). i'll draft a slimmed-down mentor handbook and a slide deck.
Hakim Olufemi: mentor capacity: we have 6 confirmed mentors, 2 tentative. can expand if we offer small honorarium or partner credits. rotation note: prefer 2-week shifts rather than weekly to reduce context switching.
Katie Wu: for hardware windows, NexusCloud partner has 3 reserved racks on 2024-08-05..2024-08-20 and Oct slots. need to align cohort dates with their staging API access. also, for on-prem partners we need an access checklist + remote console creds. pinged Nexus about extended support.
Maria Chen: @Samir can you post the roster csv by EOD? include name, timezone, skills (quantization/ops/infra), and preferred shift length. @Hakim if we do 2-week shifts, can you re-run the capacity calc?
Samir Patel: will do. attaching sample CSV template: 
```
name, email, timezone, skills, preferred_shift_weeks
Samir Patel, samir@redwood.ai, US/PST, serving-runtime,2
```
Anika Rao: for cert gating — propose 3 levels: basic (passive lab), proctored practical, and mentor badge (train-the-trainer). proctored practical needs test harness + timebox (90m). does compliance require recorded sessions?
Katie Wu: Nexus requires signed AUP for recording for cloud-hosted labs; for on-prem customers it's case-by-case. we can offer opt-in recording and automated anonymization.
Hakim Olufemi: mentor badge idea: mentors must pass a short rubric and teach one live lab. recommend mentor shadow week before running cohorts.
Maria Chen: logistics recap: playbook draft (Anika), roster csv (Samir), capacity calc (Hakim), hardware windows + AUP (Katie). target: ship playbook + dates by next Tue (1735679800). i'll run a short readout with SI leads Thurs.
onboarding-bot: calendar invite created: "SI Live Labs — planning readout" Thu 15:00 PT. attendees: Maria Chen, Samir Patel, Anika Rao, Hakim Olufemi, Katie Wu. link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/si-live-labs
Samir Patel: acked, i'll upload the roster to the shared drive (partnerships/si-live-labs/roster.csv) when ready. :white_check_mark:
Anika Rao: adding a short eval set to track regressions across cohorts — will add to the playbook as appendix.
Hakim Olufemi: noting mentor overlap risk with roadmap sprint weeks 32–33; i'll propose alternative mentor pool or swap plan.
Maria Chen: perfect — thanks team. next steps in the invite. if anyone needs to swap times, flag here. :raised_hands:
